tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (7.2:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: policy-blue
tokens.usage: PRIMARY AUTHORITY. Used as text on `.logo-text h1`, `.nav-link:hover`, `.nav-link.active`. 8.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: accent-red
tokens.usage: CRITICAL INDICATORS. Used as text on `.stat-value.critical`, `.stat-change.negative`, `.card-category.critical`. 6.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: ANALYTICAL DEPTH. Used as text on `body`, `.nav-link`, `.card-author strong`. 7.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: slate-light
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo-text p`, `.page-header p`, `.stat-label`. 4.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: slate-lighter
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.card-meta`. 2.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: social-link-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: text on `.footer-section p`, `.footer-links a`, `.footer-bottom`; border on `.footer-bottom`, `.category-tag`; background on `.social-link`, `.social-link:hover`, `.category-tag`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: stat-change-text
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.trend-indicator.up`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.sample: Economic Resilience in Post-Pandemic Recovery: A Comparative
styles.usage: Minor headings — as `h4.card-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Examining fiscal policy responses across 23 OECD nations rev
styles.usage: Body copy — as `p.card-description` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and metadata — as `div.card-meta` on the reference page.
